lines.text: Is a 50 pound drywall anchor really good for 50 pounds?
He hangs weight on every kind of anchor in real half inch drywall until it starts to slip.
The cheap 50 pound anchor holds 105 pounds before it moves which is twice its rating.
Because the rating has a safety margin built in since drywall is just chalky gypsum pressed between two sheets of paper.
beats: ai:extreme macro of crumbly white gypsum inside a broken drywall panel between paper layers

lines.text: Almost every anchor beats its rating when the weight pulls straight down along the wall.
But then he pulls them straight out of the wall like a shelf would.
And now the 50 pound anchor lets go at just 39 because pulling outward only fights a tiny ring of gypsum.
beats: ai:a small plastic wall anchor ripping out of drywall with crumbling white powder in slow motion

lines.text: The big snap toggle is the strongest but when it rips out it leaves a crater four inches wide.
So for anything that pulls away from the wall use a toggle that spreads the load behind the drywall.
Which anchor would you trust with your TV?
